headline: Menko: Expanding the Retail Ecosystem to Villages Strengthens Domestic Trade
summary: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto said extending the retail ecosystem to rural areas is a way to strengthen domestic trade. The remarks were reported by Antara News.
why: Government efforts to expand rural retail distribution influence domestic consumer demand and the growth of local trade in Indonesia.
